findings.title: Phpinfo Use
findings.description: The phpinfo() function is used to output information about PHP's configuration, which can reveal sensitive details about the environment. Removing this function call prevents potential attackers from gathering information that could be used to exploit vulnerabilities. This fix ensures that sensitive information is not unnecessarily exposed.

findings.fix_hint: Remove the phpinfo() function call to prevent information disclosure

attack_chains.title: SQLi to RCE
attack_chains.description: An attacker uses SQL injection to extract database credentials, then uses these credentials to gain remote code execution via a tainted exec call, achieving persistence on the system. This allows them to exfiltrate sensitive data and maintain access. The attacker starts by exploiting a SQL injection vulnerability in the 'low.php' file.
steps: Step 1: attacker uses SQL injection in 'DVWA-master/vulnerabilities/sqli/source/low.php' to extract database credentials using finding '6dcd1614'
Step 2: this gives them database credentials, which they use to gain remote code execution via a tainted exec call in 'DVWA-master/vulnerabilities/exec/source/low.php' using finding '43941139'
attack_chains.remediation: Input validation and sanitization on user input to prevent SQL injection in 'DVWA-master/vulnerabilities/sqli/source/low.php'

attack_chains.title: Phpinfo to SQLi to RCE
attack_chains.description: An attacker uses phpinfo to reveal database configuration details, then uses SQL injection to extract database credentials, and finally uses these credentials to gain remote code execution via a tainted exec call, achieving persistence on the system. This allows them to exfiltrate sensitive data and maintain access. The attacker starts by exploiting a phpinfo vulnerability in the 'phpinfo.php' file.
steps: Step 1: attacker uses phpinfo in 'DVWA-master/phpinfo.php' to reveal database configuration details using finding 'd8380f4e'
Step 2: this gives them database configuration details, which they use to craft a SQL injection attack in 'DVWA-master/vulnerabilities/sqli/source/low.php' using finding '6dcd1614'
Step 3: this gives them database credentials, which they use to gain remote code execution via a tainted exec call in 'DVWA-master/vulnerabilities/exec/source/low.php' using finding '43941139'
attack_chains.remediation: Remove or restrict access to 'DVWA-master/phpinfo.php' to prevent database configuration details from being revealed

attack_chains.title: SQLi Blind to RCE
attack_chains.description: An attacker uses blind SQL injection to extract database credentials, then uses these credentials to gain remote code execution via a tainted exec call, achieving persistence on the system. This allows them to exfiltrate sensitive data and maintain access. The attacker starts by exploiting a blind SQL injection vulnerability in the 'high.php' file.
steps: Step 1: attacker uses blind SQL injection in 'DVWA-master/vulnerabilities/sqli_blind/source/high.php' to extract database credentials using finding '74308688'
Step 2: this gives them database credentials, which they use to gain remote code execution via a tainted exec call in 'DVWA-master/vulnerabilities/exec/source/high.php' using finding 'ad1703a2'
attack_chains.remediation: Input validation and sanitization on user input to prevent blind SQL injection in 'DVWA-master/vulnerabilities/sqli_blind/source/high.php'
